name: dotnet-channels
`System.Threading.Channels`: thread-safe producer/consumer queues via `Channel<T>`, `ChannelWriter<T>`, and `ChannelReader<T>`. Covers bounded/unbounded creation, backpressure, `IAsyncEnumerable<T>`, and graceful shutdown. See [skill:dotnet-background-services], [skill:dotnet-csharp-async-patterns], and [references/detailed-examples.md](references/detailed-examples.md).

`Channel.CreateBounded<T>(capacity)` caps memory; `Channel.CreateUnbounded<T>()` can grow without limit. `BoundedChannelFullMode`: `Wait` applies backpressure; `DropOldest`, `DropNewest`, and `DropWrite` discard items. .NET 7 drop modes support `itemDropped` callbacks.

Producers use `WriteAsync(item, cancellationToken)` or `TryWrite(item)`; signal completion with `Complete()` or `TryComplete()`. Consumers can use `ReadAllAsync(cancellationToken)` or drain with `WaitToReadAsync(cancellationToken)` and `TryRead(out var item)`. Multiple consumers each receive distinct items. `SingleReader = true` and `SingleWriter = true` enable optimizations only when those conditions hold.
